fieldNotes.location: Roster coords (45.110536,-95.008269) landed in farmland ~5.5 km east of the plant; address listed 'SE' but is actually Willmar Ave SW. Corrected via web search to 2505 Willmar Ave SW; locked center 45.10870,-95.07950 on the main processing campus on the SW edge of Willmar.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Plant is fully enclosed by a continuous white privacy-slat chain-link fence (StreetView 2025). A posted sign at the north visitor gate reads 'ALL TRUCKS MUST USE SOUTH ENTRANCE' -> there is a controlled, function-separated truck gate. truckGate true.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Could not positively confirm a guard-booth structure at the truck gate from satellite or StreetView (gate obscured by fence/trees). Large USDA turkey plants often have staffed security, but with no visual confirmation classified guardShack false and flagged as uncertain.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Set true (gate present, no confirmed booth); flagged uncertain alongside guardShack.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: North gate handles visitors/employees; trucks routed to a separate south entrance per posted signage -> entry and exit functions are at distinct points -> entryExitSeparate true.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Large multi-building turkey campus with dock banks on separate building faces (raw receiving vs finished shipping typical for a slaughter+processing plant) -> shipRcvSeparate true.
fieldNotes.railServed: An active rail line runs along the SE edge of the property; spur access into the campus is plausible -> railServed true.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Extensive trailer drop yards in the SW with 100+ trailers parked in rows -> dropYard true; dropArea 50+.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: ~45 dock doors estimated across multiple building faces; banded 25-50, low-confidence.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved entrances and large yard space leave room for an express/bypass lane.
